result.instructions: Tools for Cledara, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which applications in our Cledara workspace are active, and when do they renew?"; "Show our Cledara transactions for October 2026 and total the debits."; "Get the invoice download link for this Cledara transaction.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Cledara data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run cledara_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run cledara_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run cledara_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. cledara_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: cledara_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List the applications in the Cledara workspace of this API key, with status, budget, owner, teams, balance and the next renewal or payment date. Good first call to see which SaaS applications are tracked. Cledara API: GET /v0/applications.

tools.name: cledara_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List transactions in the Cledara workspace: amount (negative for debits), currency, account type, application, invoice flag and accounting fields. Filter by time window (`from` is after, `to` is before, RFC 3339), by application ids, and page with `offset`. The result has `hasMore`, `nextOffset` and `totalCount`; pass `nextOffset` as `offset` for the next page. Cledara API: GET /v0/transactions.

from.description: Only transactions after this RFC 3339 date-time, for example 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.

to.description: Only transactions before this RFC 3339 date-time, for example 2026-01-31T23:59:59Z.

applicationIds.description: Only transactions of these application ids.

tools.name: cledara_get_transaction_invoice_url
tools.title: Get transaction invoice URL
tools.description: Get a download URL for a transaction's invoice. The URL is valid for 5 minutes. Check `hasInvoice` in cledara_list_transactions first; a transaction without an invoice or an unknown id returns an error. Cledara API: GET /v0/transactions/{transactionId}/invoice-url.
